title: 利率上升市场不跌：盈利惊喜率30%，估值高企有支撑？
speaker: Mark Conan

segments.en: so there are real opportunities so it's a question of matching capital to where the demand for that credit is and that's the mechanism we're seeing
segments.zh: 所以存在真实机会，问题是将资本匹配到信贷需求所在，这正是我们看到的机制

segments.en: rates are higher ordinarily you would expect to come back to your original question ordinarily you would expect that to be impacting negatively on the stock market
segments.zh: 利率更高，通常你会预期这对股市产生负面影响

segments.en: yeah and you would say oh equity is now looking a little bit pricey a little bit overvalued but what we're seeing is it's all predicated on what I started with
segments.zh: 你可能会说权益资产看起来有点贵，有点高估，但我们看到的一切都基于我一开始说的

segments.en: which is expectation of the neutral real rate being sustained at a higher level because of the productivity gains
segments.zh: 即中性实际利率因生产率提升而维持在高位的预期

segments.en: now if you ask me where those gains are accruing we can't see it yet it's still that the returns are accruing to the providers of these services
segments.zh: 如果你问我这些收益在哪里体现，我们还看不到，目前回报流向了服务提供商

segments.en: the manufacturers of these chips the and now it's going into the infrastructure we're not really seeing evidence evidence of improving earnings margins
segments.zh: 芯片制造商，现在进入基础设施，我们尚未看到利润率改善的证据

segments.en: in company earnings reports about the expectation that's what that's what investors are expecting
segments.zh: 在公司财报中，这还只是预期，但投资者正是这样预期的

segments.en: we've been seeing you mentioned about what we're seeing the issue as the debt mark I mean we're seeing the spreads wide in a little bit that in some of these tech players
segments.zh: 你提到债务市场的问题，我们看到一些科技公司的利差有所扩大

segments.en: right are we likely to see a little bit more that spilling over to you know other debt mark I mean I'm just wondering like we're seeing a little bit of strain but does it spill over to other out
segments.zh: 这种压力是否会蔓延到其他债务市场？我们正看到一些紧张，但会扩散吗？

segments.en: well it's an interesting question because what we've seen since really about 2015 is in the public markets spreads have been extremely tight
segments.zh: 这是个有趣的问题，因为自2015年以来，公开市场利差一直非常紧

segments.en: and there's a real crowding out and for long-term investors that means you're not getting enough return for the risk you're taking
segments.zh: 存在真正的挤出效应，对长期投资者而言，这意味着风险回报不足

segments.en: particularly when you go out longer dated so the reward you're getting for taking on credit term risk is not there
segments.zh: 尤其是期限更长时，承担信用期限风险的回报并不存在

segments.en: and that's driven a lot of investors long-term investors into the private markets because that's where the spread is is accruing
segments.zh: 这促使许多长期投资者转向私募市场，因为那里有利差积累

segments.en: and what's the read through across equity markets then is this bullish equity markets yeah so deal with the US because that's you know most what is driving global sentiment
segments.zh: 这对股市意味着什么？是否利好股市？先看美国，因为它主导全球情绪

segments.en: we're seeing a broadening out so a lot of the earnings that we've seen it's over 80% of companies reported earnings ahead of expectations
segments.zh: 我们看到市场正在拓宽，超过80%的公司财报超预期

segments.en: earning surprises on the S&P were around 30% of those that reported so we've seen a tremendous continuation of momentum on earnings
segments.zh: 标普500的盈利惊喜率约30%，盈利动能持续强劲
